title: Fools and Sluggards

questions.question: Like snow in summer or rain in harvest, so honor is not fitting for a what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 26:1 (ESV): "so honor is not fitting for a fool."

questions.question: Answer not a fool according to his folly, lest you be like whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 26:4 (ESV): "lest you be like him yourself."

questions.question: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 26:5 (ESV): "lest he be wise in his own eyes."

questions.question: As a door turns on its hinges, so does a sluggard on his what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 26:14 (ESV): "so does a sluggard on his bed."

questions.question: The sluggard says, "There is a lion in the road! There is a lion in the what?"
questions.explanation: Proverbs 26:13 (ESV): "There is a lion in the streets!"

questions.question: Like a lame man's legs, which hang useless, is a proverb in the mouth of whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 26:7 (ESV): "is a proverb in the mouth of fools."

questions.question: Like a dog that returns to his vomit is a fool who repeats his what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 26:11 (ESV): "is a fool who repeats his folly."

questions.question: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who can answer how?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 26:16 (ESV): "than seven men who can answer sensibly."

questions.question: Whoever meddles in a quarrel not his own is like one who takes a passing dog by the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 26:17 (ESV): "is like one who takes a passing dog by the ears."

questions.question: For lack of wood the fire goes out, and where there is no whisperer, quarreling does what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 26:20 (ESV): "and where there is no whisperer, quarreling ceases."

questions.question: Like a madman who throws firebrands, arrows, and death is the man who deceives his neighbor and says, "I am only..." what?
Like the glaze covering an earthen vessel are fervent lips with an evil what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 26:23 (ESV): "are fervent lips with an evil heart."

questions.question: Whoever digs a pit will fall into it, and a stone will come back on him who starts it doing what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 26:27 (ESV): "and a stone will come back on him who starts it rolling."

questions.question: A lying tongue hates its victims, and a flattering mouth works what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 26:28 (ESV): "and a flattering mouth works ruin."

questions.question: Like one who binds the stone in the sling is one who gives honor to a what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 26:8 (ESV): "is one who gives honor to a fool."

key_verse_text: Answer not a fool according to his folly, lest you be like him yourself. Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own eyes.
